exampleEn: After a long day, I need to pull myself together before meeting my friends.
exampleKo: 긴 하루를 보낸 후, 친구들을 만나기 전에 마음을 다잡아야 해.
gameExamples: When I started feeling overwhelmed, I knew I had to pull oneself together to focus on my tasks.
